About The Company

Haley & Aldrich is a renowned consulting firm dedicated to addressing some of the most significant challenges in the built and natural environments. With a legacy dating back to 1957, the company has grown into a team of over 1,000 engineers and scientists across the United States. Their mission centers on working closely with clients to navigate change, creating safer, more resilient communities and sustainable solutions. Haley & Aldrich prides itself on technical excellence, innovative problem-solving, and empathetic leadership, making a lasting impact on public and private sector projects. The company fosters a culture of continuous learning and professional development, ensuring its team remains at the forefront of industry advancements. Committed to diversity and inclusion, Haley & Aldrich is an equal opportunity employer that values the unique contributions of all individuals.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Environmental Data Analyst to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis. This role offers the flexibility of remote work within the United States, with an option for a hybrid work environment combining remote and office-based activities. As an integral part of our Environmental Data Management team, you will support various environmental investigation and remediation projects by managing, analyzing, and visualizing environmental data. The ideal candidate will bring a creative approach to data collection, management, and presentation, helping to produce clear and compelling data products that support informed decision-making. This position provides an excellent opportunity to work with talented professionals across the country, contribute to impactful projects, and enhance your expertise in environmental data analysis and management.

Qualifications

BS/BA degree in geology, environmental science, chemistry, mathematics, statistics, or a related field
3 to 5 years of experience in environmental data management and analysis within the environmental consulting industry
Proficiency with environmental relational database management systems such as EarthSoft EQuIS, Power BI, and OpenGround
Experience with database software including MS SQL Server and MS Access
Strong skills in manipulating and organizing datasets in MS Excel for database import and reporting
Ability to manage and report on chemicals encountered in environmental investigations, including metals, VOCs, SVOCs, fuels, pesticides, PCBs, and PFAS
Knowledge of federal and state environmental regulations and electronic deliverable requirements is a plus
Excellent organizational, time-management, and attention to detail skills
Strong analytical, judgment, and problem-solving capabilities
High initiative and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

Responsibilities

Manage and analyze environmental data for a variety of investigations and remediation projects
Develop innovative methods for data collection, management, and visualization to improve project outcomes
Create concise, accurate, and visually appealing data products to support project goals
Provide guidance and support to scientists and engineers on data utilization and interpretation
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across the United States to meet project requirements and client needs
Ensure data quality, consistency, and compliance with regulatory standards
Demonstrate strong organizational skills by managing multiple tasks and deadlines effectively
Continuously seek opportunities to improve data management processes and tools

Benefits

Competitive salary range of $65,000 - $85,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications
Eligible for a sign-on bonus
Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance
Retirement plan options
Flexible work arrangements with remote and hybrid options
Opportunities for professional growth and development
Supportive and inclusive work environment

Equal Opportunity

Haley & Aldrich is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We believe diversity enhances our ability to serve clients effectively and innovate continuously. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

jobs.description:
About Zoox

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

About Our Contract Student Worker Program

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

Role Overview

As a Data Analyst supporting Zoox Operations, you will help define how we measure and improve the teams responsible for vehicle readiness, fleet response, base operations, infrastructure operations, and training. You will translate complex operational workflows into trusted metrics, scalable data models, and clear dashboards. Your work will give leaders greater visibility into operational performance and help teams identify opportunities to improve safety, quality, efficiency, and scalability.

Responsibilities

Partner with Operations leaders to define meaningful performance metrics and reporting requirements.
Build and maintain data models, dashboards, and recurring reporting using SQL, Databricks, and Python.
Analyze operational performance, identify trends and root causes, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

Required Qualifications

Establish data-quality checks and investigate gaps that could affect the accuracy or reliability of reporting
[placeholder]
Use AI to accelerate data exploration, code development, insight generation, and recurring reporting
Prototype AI-enabled workflows that detect anomalies, summarize performance, automate business-review preparation, and surface actions for operational leaders

Bonus Qualifications

Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science partners to improve underlying data sources and instrumentation.
Currently pursuing or recently completed a master’s degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, industrial engineering, operations research, statistics, economics, or a related field
An AI-native analytical skill set, with demonstrated experience using LLMs, coding copilots, or AI-enabled analytics tools to accelerate data exploration, write and debug SQL or Python, automate reporting, and communicate insights
Support weekly business reviews by developing clear performance narratives and surfacing risks and opportunities.
Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing complex datasets.
Experience building dashboards or data visualizations using Databricks, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or a similar platform.
Help establish metric ownership, targets, and sustainable reporting processes.
Ability to translate ambiguous operational questions into structured analysis.

Program Requirements

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain insights to non-technical audiences.
Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.
A collaborative, proactive approach and comfort working in a fast-moving environment.
Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.
Able to commit a minimum of 20 hours per week.
Able to work on-site at in Foster City CA.
Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

We want to be transparent: this is not an internship.
The Contract Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience in a professional environment.

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Description

Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving – Evaluates complex datasets, identifies trends and root causes, and develops actionable recommendations.

Self-Initiative – Prioritizes work, investigates issues independently, and proactively brings forward solutions without requiring detailed direction.
Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic environments where workflows, systems, reporting requirements, and business priorities evolve rapidly.
Quality & Accuracy – Ensures data integrity through validation, proactively identifies discrepancies, and delivers reporting leaders can trust.
Business Partnership – Collaborates effectively across Operations, Revenue Cycle, Order Management, Patient Access, Patient Experience, Sales, Finance, IT, and external vendor partners.
Communication & Strategic Insight – Translates complex data into clear, actionable insights through dashboards, reports, presentations, and executive-level recommendations.
Change Leadership – Challenges existing processes, identifies opportunities for improvement, and helps drive organizational change through data-driven insights.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Business Intelligence & Reporting

Develop and maintain dashboards, KPI scorecards, operational reports, and recurring reporting packages.
Build reporting for Patient Access, Intake, Post-Ship Support, Order Management, Revenue Cycle, Patient Experience, Workers’ Compensation, Personal Injury, Sales, Finance, and Leadership.

Create interim tracking methods when required data is not available through existing systems or vendor platforms.

Support KPI standardization, metric definitions, reporting governance, and data quality improvement.

Leverage AI and automation tools to improve reporting efficiency, reduce manual reporting, and generate insights.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM’s
growing Water business is seeking a motivated Geologist/Geophysicist/Geoscientist
to join our Geotechnical and Geophysics Group in Germantown, Maryland.

This position offers a unique combination of field investigation, technical analysis, and office-based project work. Team members participate in projects from field data collection through data processing, interpretation, mapping, and development of technical deliverables. The successful candidate will have opportunities to develop experience across multiple geophysical and geoscience disciplines while working alongside experienced geologists, geophysicists, engineers, surveyors, and GIS professionals.

The position is based in our Germantown, Maryland office and includes a combination of office and field assignments. While this is primarily an in-person position, hybrid work opportunities may be available following completion of the initial training period and once the employee has demonstrated the ability to work effectively and independently. Depending on project needs, up to approximately 50% travel may be required for field investigations, although the balance between field and office work will vary throughout the year. Field assignments may range from local day trips to occasional multi-week assignments throughout the United States and abroad.

Prior geophysics experience is beneficial but is not required. We place a high value on technical aptitude, curiosity, initiative, dependability, and a willingness to learn. The successful candidate should enjoy both solving technical problems in the office and being actively involved in collecting high-quality data in the field.

Our team supports a broad range of engineering and infrastructure projects involving renewable energy, pumped-storage facilities, tunnels, defense facilities, dams, data centers, bridges, roadways, and other complex infrastructure. This position provides exposure to projects ranging from initial site characterization through engineering design and construction.

This position is expected to begin in September 2026.

The job responsibilities of the position will include but are not limited to:
Supporting geophysical investigations from field data acquisition through processing, interpretation, mapping, and reporting.
Supporting terrestrial, marine, and borehole investigations using methods including seismic refraction/reflection, MASW, ground penetrating radar (GPR), electromagnetics, magnetics, electrical resistivity imaging, utility mapping, borehole geophysical logging, downhole/cross hole seismic, bathymetric surveying, side-scan sonar, sub-bottom profiling, and marine magnetics and seismic.
Performing technical office work including geophysical data processing and interpretation, GIS analysis and mapping, CAD development, data management, quality control, technical documentation, and report preparation.
Performing field investigations, including setup and operation of specialized geophysical and survey instrumentation, deployment of sensors and cables, operation of seismic sources, field data quality control, troubleshooting, and equipment mobilization.
Supporting geodetic, geological, and geotechnical services including surveying, GIS mapping, geologic mapping, vibration and settlement monitoring, soil borings, and rock coring.
Operating specialized geophysical, survey, and data-acquisition equipment and progressively developing the skills necessary to independently perform increasingly complex field and office assignments.
Conducting specific phases of projects and assigned field activities under the general supervision of a Project Manager or senior technical team member.
Evaluating field data in real time, identifying potential problems or unexpected conditions, and working with senior staff to determine appropriate solutions.
Reviewing collected data for completeness and quality and identifying data that may require additional investigation or collection.
Maintaining organized field documentation and digital data and performing appropriate quality-control checks.
Preparing technical documentation, figures, maps, summaries, and portions of technical reports.
Working collaboratively as part of multidisciplinary project teams and small field crews.
Traveling up to approximately 50% as project needs require.
Taking ownership of assigned tasks and progressively assuming greater responsibility for field activities and technical assignments.

BA/BS in Geology, Geophysics, Geosciences, Geological Engineering, Environmental Science, Geography/GIS or related field + 2 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
Ability and willingness to travel up to approximately 50% to support field investigations, including occasional multi-week assignments
Ability to perform physically active field work outdoors, including prolonged standing and walking over uneven terrain, repeated bending and lifting, and lifting and carrying field equipment weighing up to approximately 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation
Ability and willingness to work outdoors in varying terrain and weather conditions and occasionally work extended field days or non-standard schedules based on project requirements
Valid US Driver’s License and as a condition of employment must pass the AECOM Motor Vehicle screening
As a condition of employment, candidates must pass a drug screening
As a condition of employment, candidates must pass a medical screening
Due to the nature of the work, U.S. Citizenship is required

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Master's Degree in Geology, Geophysics, Geosciences, Geological Engineering, Environmental Science, Geography/GIS or related field
Previous geophysics experience is not required. We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate intellectual curiosity, initiative, reliability, technical aptitude, and a strong desire to develop both field and analytical skills
Experience involving geology, geophysics, geotechnical investigations, environmental investigations, surveying, GIS, engineering, or other related technical work
Demonstrated ability to complete assigned field and technical tasks with appropriate guidance from senior staff
Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to learn new equipment, software, and technical procedures
A hands-on mindset and willingness to participate fully in field assignments as part of a small project team
Demonstrated initiative and ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and follow them through to completion
Hands-on experience with surveying, construction, environmental field work, geotechnical investigations, outdoor field work, research, military service, trades, or similar experience is beneficial
Strong mechanical or technical aptitude and an interest in understanding, operating, and troubleshooting specialized instrumentation
Experience collecting, reviewing, organizing, and documenting scientific or engineering field data.
Ability to recognize potential field equipment, data-quality, or site-condition issues and assist in developing practical solutions
Ability to balance physically active field assignments with detailed technical and analytical office work
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word
Familiarity with GIS, CAD, surveying, electronics, programming, data acquisition, or technical instrumentation is beneficial
Familiarity with software such as ArcGIS Pro, Surfer, EarthImager, SeisImager, RADAN, or AutoCAD experience

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data analyst like you to bring your knowledge to support the United States Marine Corps.

As a client-facing data analyst on our Global Defense Team, you’ll work closely with Marines to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on strategic engagements, process improvement, visualization, and analysis.

How You’ll Contribute:

Use your technical knowledge and analytical mindset to support client and stakeholder relationships.
Identify, connect, and consolidate data from multiple sources across communication functions, including social and digital media analytics, media monitoring platforms, survey and engagement data, website analytics, and internal reporting systems.
Build and maintain data pipelines and connectors such as Power Automate flows, Dataverse tables, Excel, and SharePoint sources to automate recurring data ingestion.
Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis of communication data to identify trends, patterns, correlations, and gaps over time.
Translate communication goals and objectives into measurable indicators, metrics, and key performance indicators (KPIs) across outputs, outtakes, outcomes, and organizational impact.
Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting processes using Power Automate and other Microsoft Power Platform tools.
Design and build interactive dashboards, reports, and data models that present assessment findings clearly to senior leaders and staff.
Develop recurring and on-demand visual products such as trend charts, scorecards, and heat maps that communicate performance against KPIs.

Work with us to help drive large-scale communication strategy and process decisions through data insights.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

Experience with building interactive dashboards, reports, and data models
Experience with data exploration, data cleaning, data visualization, and predictive modeling
Experience using Microsoft Power Platform Tools such as Power Automate
Experience with Python including Pandas, NumPy, API integration, SQL, ETL, and ELT
Ability to brief senior leaders
Ability to conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis of data to identify trends, patterns, correlations, and gaps over time
Ability to build and maintain data pipelines and connectors to automate recurring data ingestion
Secret clearance
Bachelor's degree

Nice If You Have:

Experience building internal analytics platforms and data products
Experience with translating leadership priorities and assessment requirements into analytic products
Experience with Databricks or PySpark
Knowledge of application architecture design
Knowledge of machine learning including classification, clustering, and evaluation metrics

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. About the Job.

JPI is seeking an Architectural Project Coordinator to support the design, production, and construction administration of multifamily projects. This position reports directly to the Director of Architectural Production and plays a key role within the Architectural Production Studio by helping coordinate design efforts across all project phases.

The ideal candidate will bring 3-7 years of multifamily experience and a strong ability to support architectural production in a fast-paced environment. This role offers hands-on exposure to schematic design, design development, construction documents, and construction administration, while working closely with Project Architects, Studio Directors, consultants, and internal JPI teams. The Architectural Project Coordinator helps transform design concepts into coordinated drawing sets, supports consultant integration, and assists with construction-phase documentation to ensure smooth project delivery.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

Project Coordination: Support the Architectural Project Manager in coordinating multiple projects through all phases from schematic design to construction administration. Assist with tracking project schedules, deliverables, and coordination items to ensure milestones are met. Help organize internal and external coordination meetings, page turns, and design reviews.
Design and Documentation: Assist in the production and coordination of schematic design (SD), design development (DD), and construction documents (CD).
Utilize a kit of parts approach to architectural design, leveraging pre-approved components to streamline the design process and maximize efficiency.

Construction Administration: Support the CA department with RFI inquiries.
Team Coordination: Coordinate with external consultants (Civil engineers, MEP engineers, interior designers, contractors, and other stakeholders) to support cohesive project delivery.
Assist senior staff in managing communication and follow-up items across disciplines.

Teamwork: Work closely with the Senior Project Manager, the Architectural Production Studio Director, and the Architectural CA Studio Director to support staffing, workflow, and phase transitions.
JPI Departments: Collaborate with internal design teams, development, investment management, preconstruction, and construction to integrate architectural design requirements into overall project planning.
Quality Control: Assist with internal quality reviews to ensure drawing sets align with building codes, JPI standards, and construction requirements. Help track and verify incorporation of value engineering items, accessibility comments, and waterproofing review comments.
Client and Stakeholder Management: Support project communication by helping prepare materials, tracking responses, and documenting decisions. Assist in maintaining clear communication between internal teams and external partners.
Resource Management: Help track project timelines, consultant deliverables, and internal deadlines. Assist with workload coordination and task prioritization as directed by the Director of Design.
Innovation and Problem-Solving: Contribute to architectural design with creative solutions and innovative approaches. Identify and address design challenges throughout the project lifecycle.
Industry Knowledge: Stay updated on the latest trends, technologies, and best practices in multifamily architecture and construction, integrating them into the design and documentation process.

Pre-Dev / Conceptual Design Phase
Conceptual Design Analysis: Assist with reviewing site plans and elevation studies for coordination, zoning compliance, and completeness.
Kit of Parts Evaluation: Assess the application of the “kit of parts” approach in the site plan, focusing on standardization to streamline future production efforts while maintaining design integrity.
Concept Set Review: Assist with the review of the concept set, ensuring it is complete and aligns with the overall project strategy. Provide feedback and markups to ensure readiness for the next design phase.
Visual Communication: Support elevation and graphic reviews for internal discussions and presentations.
Collaborative Leadership: Assist the Senior Project Manager with organizing consultant proposals and tracking scopes.

Schematic Design Phase – Arch Production Studio
Civil Coordination: Assist with tracking site constraints and civil coordination items.
Third-Party Consultant Integration: Facilitate coordination between in-house teams and external consultants, ensuring all stakeholders (structural, MEP, interior design, and landscape architecture) are aligned and progressing according to the project schedule.
Detailed Unit Approval: Assist with tracking unit layout approvals and internal sign-offs.
Schematic Design Set Delivery: Support the production of a fully coordinated Schematic Design (SD) set in Revit, managing both in-house and outsourced resources, and ensuring timely delivery to internal and external stakeholders.
Value Engineering (VE) Review: Track VE items and document decisions made during SD reviews.

Development Phase – Arch Production Studio
Drawing Quality Control: Assist with organizing DD reviews and incorporating markups. Ensure all drawings meet project specifications and JPI’s high-quality standards.
Integration of Value Engineering: Assist with organizing DD reviews and incorporating markups.
Design Coordination: Assist coordination efforts across all disciplines (architectural, structural, MEP) through the DD Pageturn meeting. Ensure full collaboration between internal and external teams, identifying and resolving any design conflicts early in the process.
Documentation & Feedback: Issue the DD set and the DD Revised set to all relevant parties and actively participate in design discussions to ensure feedback is incorporated promptly.

Construction Documents Phase – Arch Production Studio
CD Coordination: Assist with coordinating architectural, structural, and MEP inputs into the CD set.
Consultant Collaboration: Help organize CD pageturn meetings and track follow-up items.
Compliance Tracking: Assist with incorporating accessibility and waterproofing review comments.
Permit & GMP Set Support: Help prepare and organize CD sets for permit and GMP pricing issuance.

IFC Set & Preconstruction – Arch CA Studio
Assist with verifying that permit comments, accessibility comments, waterproofing comments, and coordination items are incorporated into the final IFC set.

Construction Administration – Arch CA Studio
RFI & Submittal Assistance: Assist the CA department in responding to RFIs and submittals by preparing background information, markups, and reference materials for review by the CA team. This role does not issue responses directly to contractors.
Design Intent Support: Help verify that RFI and submittal responses align with the approved design intent, construction documents, and JPI standards under the direction of the CA team.
Construction Issue Support: Provide design support to the CA team for field-related questions, helping research drawings, details, and prior decisions to facilitate timely responses.

Non-essential Duties And Responsibilities

Other duties as assigned.

Education, Work Experience, & Physical Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Architecture.
3–7 years of experience in architectural production or project coordination, preferably with multifamily projects.
Proficiency in Revit; experience with AutoCAD, SketchUp, and Bluebeam Revu preferred.
Familiarity with Procore or similar project management platforms.
Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
Working knowledge of zoning regulations, building codes, and construction documentation standards.
Strong communication, organization, and coordination skills.

Job Details

Description

Working with a high degree of ownership and attention to detail, the Clinical Documentation Specialist reviews documentation for completeness, identifies gaps or inconsistencies, communicates documentation requirements, and helps resolve documentation barriers that may delay patient care or reimbursement.

Core Competencies

Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving – Evaluates complex datasets, identifies trends and root causes, and develops actionable recommendations.
Vendor Data Curiosity – Identifies data gaps and partners with vendors to define, validate, and operationalize new data fields.
Self-Initiative – Prioritizes work, investigates issues independently, and proactively brings forward solutions without requiring detailed direction.
Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic environments where workflows, systems, reporting requirements, and business priorities evolve rapidly.
Quality & Accuracy – Ensures data integrity through validation, proactively identifies discrepancies, and delivers reporting leaders can trust.
Business Partnership – Collaborates effectively across Operations, Revenue Cycle, Order Management, Patient Access, Patient Experience, Sales, Finance, IT, and external vendor partners.
Communication & Strategic Insight – Translates complex data into clear, actionable insights through dashboards, reports, presentations, and executive-level recommendations.
Change Leadership – Challenges existing processes, identifies opportunities for improvement, and helps drive organizational change through data-driven insights.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Business Intelligence & Reporting

Develop and maintain dashboards, KPI scorecards, operational reports, and recurring reporting packages.
Build reporting for Patient Access, Intake, Post-Ship Support, Order Management, Revenue Cycle, Patient Experience, Workers’ Compensation, Personal Injury, Sales, Finance, and Leadership.
Monitor organizational and departmental performance against established KPIs, operational goals, service levels, and productivity expectations.
Analyze data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, bottlenecks, and root causes; translate findings into practical recommendations.

Vendor Data Field Identification & Capture

Identify missing or incomplete data fields needed for KPI tracking, workflow management, reporting, and business decisions.
Partner with vendors, system owners, and stakeholders to define, request, validate, and implement new data fields.
Document field definitions, expected values, reporting purpose, downstream operational impact, and data collection requirements.
Create interim tracking methods when required data is not available through existing systems or vendor platforms.

Data Management & Analytics

Write, maintain, and validate SQL queries to extract and analyze operational, vendor, and enterprise data.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reporting integrity across multiple systems.
Support KPI standardization, metric definitions, reporting governance, and data quality improvement.
Use Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, and similar tools to extract, transform, analyze, and visualize business data.
Leverage AI and automation tools to improve reporting efficiency, reduce manual reporting, and generate insights.

Patient Access, Intake & Contact Center Analytics

Report on referral volume, intake productivity, call performance, conversion rates, order completion, and intake turnaround times.
Monitor individual and team performance metrics such as service levels, speed to answer, abandonment rate, first call resolution, handle time, quality, and work queues.
Evaluate intake workflow efficiency, referral aging, order abandonment, and process gaps affecting patient onboarding.
Conduct root cause analysis for patient cancellations, escalations, complaint patterns, service failures, and delayed order progression.

Post-Ship Support Analytics

Analyze post-shipment interactions, including delivery confirmation, education, troubleshooting, resupply, billing inquiries, satisfaction, and issue resolution.
Evaluate trends related to product issues, shipping delays, returns, delivery failures, escalations, and patient complaints.
Design dashboards for delivery success, follow-up compliance, patient engagement, utilization, and post-shipment support performance.
Identify workflow gaps that affect timely patient follow-up, billing readiness, issue resolution, and ongoing patient support.

Process Improvement & Operational Partnership

Partner with operational leaders to identify inefficiencies, workflow gaps, reporting needs, and improvement opportunities.
Translate operational challenges into measurable, data-driven solutions and recommendations.
Measure the effectiveness of operational, vendor, process, and business changes.
Present insights through dashboards, summaries, presentations, and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

Required

Experience & Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Finance, Statistics, Information Systems, Mathematics, Healthcare Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience.
3 to 5 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, revenue operations, healthcare analytics, call center analytics, data analysis, or a related field.
Advanced SQL and Excel skills.
Experience developing dashboards, scorecards, data visualizations, and recurring reporting solutions.
Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and data validation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, recurring reports, and ad hoc analytical requests.
Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly to operational and leadership audiences.
Demonstrated ability to identify missing data, define reporting requirements, and partner with stakeholders or vendors to improve data capture.

Preferred

Healthcare, DME, revenue cycle, workers’ compensation, personal injury, patient access, intake, order management, or call center experience.
Experience working with vendor platforms and requesting or validating new reporting fields.
Experience supporting executive leadership teams.
Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or other process improvement methodologies.
Knowledge of healthcare insurance processes, patient intake workflows, billing operations, post-shipment support, and DME operations.

Candidates should have experience with several of the following technologies:

Core Technologies: SQL, Tableau, Advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and Microsoft Planner.
Preferred Experience: NetSuite, ShipStation, Dialpad, NikoHealth, Emitrr, Alteryx, and other healthcare, revenue cycle, CRM, or enterprise reporting platforms.

Success in This Role

Within The First 6–12 Months, This Individual Will

Improve visibility into operational performance, patient access trends, post-ship support, and revenue-enabling workflows.
Reduce manual reporting through automation and improved data capture.
Establish trusted KPI reporting, metric definitions, and reporting governance standards.
Identify vendor data gaps and help implement new fields needed for reporting and operational decisions.
Deliver recommendations that improve productivity, service quality, patient experience, and operational outcomes.
Serve as a go-to resource for operational insights, business intelligence, vendor data questions, and reporting improvement.

GeoStabilization International (GSI), Access Limited, and RoadGuard together form a leading infrastructure solutions platform dedicated to protecting people and strengthening critical infrastructure across North America and New Zealand.

GSI is the premier geohazard mitigation firm specializing in emergency slope stabilization, landslide repair, grouting, and micropiles through innovative design-build delivery. Access Limited brings over a century of steep-slope expertise and operates North America’s largest fleet of spider excavators, delivering complex rockfall and geotechnical solutions in the most challenging environments. Across all our businesses, we are driven by innovation, extreme ownership, technical excellence, and a relentless commitment to measurable results that improve safety and infrastructure resilience.

Founded in 2024 by GeoStabilization International, RoadGuard brings together eight industry-leading road safety companies dedicated to strengthening the nation’s roadways. The team’s combined expertise lies in crafting and implementing optimized solutions that prioritize the safety of individuals and improve infrastructure across the United States.

RoadGuard’s specialized services include guardrail/ guide rail installation, commercial fencing solutions, bridge railing services, highway signage, and specialty fabrication.

About The Role

The Senior Project Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight for high-impact projects and programs. This role leads cross-functional teams, manages complex project portfolios, and ensures successful delivery aligned with organizational goals. Serving as both a mentor to project managers and a strategic partner to leadership, the Sr. PM drives innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the project management function.

Responsibilities

Provide strategic leadership for complex, high-value projects and programs, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and performance goals.
Oversee planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and execution across multiple concurrent projects to ensure delivery within scope, schedule, and budget.
Partner with executive leadership to define priorities, manage project portfolios, and support long-range business objectives.
Lead, mentor, and develop project managers and teams, driving accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement in project delivery.
Foster effective communication across internal departments, clients, and external partners to manage expectations and ensure alignment.
Monitor performance metrics, identify and mitigate risks, and deliver clear executive-level reporting on progress and outcomes.
Drive process improvement and change initiatives, standardizing tools, methodologies, and best practices that elevate project management performance.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in construction project management, Civil Engineering, or related field; master’s preferred.
3+ years of experience leading complex, multi-disciplinary, or strategic projects.
PMP certification preferred.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage competing priorities, and deliver results aligned with organizational goals.
Strong communication, leadership, and analytical skills with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
Proficient in modern project management tools and methodologies.

Phillips 66 & YOU - Together we can fuel the future

The Field Technician
is responsible for operational, mechanical, and instrument\electrical functions, such as inspection, troubleshooting, repair, and replacement of equipment to ensure safe and reliable operations. This work includes such activities as supervising/directing field crews, maintaining pipelines in compliance with contracts, regulations, and safety considerations, coordinating with on-site contractors, and ensuring cost effective and safe operations. Employee(s) in this position may have some environmental or safety activities associated with their responsibilities. The Field Technician will be working and traveling between the booster stations in the Greeley, CO area.

This position requires the successful completion of an online assessment. If you meet the required qualifications of the position, a link to complete the assessment will be emailed to you immediately after your completed application is received. Please check your spam folder if you do not see the email.

The assessment must be completed within 7 days of your application date OR prior to the job posting expiration date, whichever is earlier. The job posting expiration date is listed at the bottom of this job posting. Your assessment results will be valid for one year.

What You’ll Do

Conducts routine inspection of equipment and facilities (equipment health, security, AVO- Audio, Visual, Olfactory), operation of liquid handling systems, and operation of dehydration systems.
Conducts pipeline pigging, hydrate management, etc.
Responsible for Startup, Shutdown, and operating gas compression equipment.
Maintains pipeline ROW such as markers, signs, and vegetation, exposures.
Performs minor maintenance on rotating equipment (e.g., belts, hot valves, fans, etc.)
Maintains records in accordance with Pipeline regulatory requirements.
Conducts routine inspection, calibration and repair of meter and associated equipment (meter tube/plates, ultrasonic meter, flow computer).
Performs maintenance and repair of mechanical equipment such as block valves, control valves, air compressors, manual valve actuators, etc.
Performs maintenance and repair of and fixed equipment such as filters (all types), strainers, dehydration systems, etc.
Conducts routine inspection, such as transmitters, switches, fire eyes, hazardous gas detection, level detection, etc.
Operate PLC, HMI equipment, software, pipeline valves and actuators.
Maintain and repair motor control equipment.
Operation and maintenance of compression equipment and pumps.

What You’ll Bring – Required

Legally authorized to work in the job posting country.
High School Diploma or GED or greater
Have and maintain a valid driver’s license.
Willing and able to with or without reasonable accommodations:
Lift a minimum of 50 pounds.
Occasionally exerts pulling force of 130 pounds.
Regularly stoops, squats, kneels, and crouches for durations up to 30 minutes.
Works safely near large, hot, high-speed machines.
Work inside gas plant conditions as well as in outside conditions that include inclement weather, heat, and humidity.

To remain on-call, as needed
To work shift schedule, including, but not limited to days, nights, weekend, holidays, rotating shift
Periodically pulls/pushes doors open to move around the gas plant.
Occasionally may climb A-frame ladders.

What Makes You Stand Out – Preferred

Completion of Tech school program

3 or more years of oil and gas operations experience

Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM’s
growing Water business is seeking a motivated Geologist/Geophysicist/Geoscientist
to join our Geotechnical and Geophysics Group in Germantown, Maryland.

This position offers a unique combination of field investigation, technical analysis, and office-based project work. Team members participate in projects from field data collection through data processing, interpretation, mapping, and development of technical deliverables. The successful candidate will have opportunities to develop experience across multiple geophysical and geoscience disciplines while working alongside experienced geologists, geophysicists, engineers, surveyors, and GIS professionals.

The position is based in our Germantown, Maryland office and includes a combination of office and field assignments. While this is primarily an in-person position, hybrid work opportunities may be available following completion of the initial training period and once the employee has demonstrated the ability to work effectively and independently. Depending on project needs, up to approximately 50% travel may be required for field investigations, although the balance between field and office work will vary throughout the year. Field assignments may range from local day trips to occasional multi-week assignments throughout the United States and abroad.

Prior geophysics experience is beneficial but is not required. We place a high value on technical aptitude, curiosity, initiative, dependability, and a willingness to learn. The successful candidate should enjoy both solving technical problems in the office and being actively involved in collecting high-quality data in the field.

Our team supports a broad range of engineering and infrastructure projects involving renewable energy, pumped-storage facilities, tunnels, defense facilities, dams, data centers, bridges, roadways, and other complex infrastructure. This position provides exposure to projects ranging from initial site characterization through engineering design and construction.

This position is expected to begin in September 2026.

The job responsibilities of the position will include but are not limited to:
Supporting geophysical investigations from field data acquisition through processing, interpretation, mapping, and reporting.
Supporting terrestrial, marine, and borehole investigations using methods including seismic refraction/reflection, MASW, ground penetrating radar (GPR), electromagnetics, magnetics, electrical resistivity imaging, utility mapping, borehole geophysical logging, downhole/cross hole seismic, bathymetric surveying, side-scan sonar, sub-bottom profiling, and marine magnetics and seismic.
Performing technical office work including geophysical data processing and interpretation, GIS analysis and mapping, CAD development, data management, quality control, technical documentation, and report preparation.
Performing field investigations, including setup and operation of specialized geophysical and survey instrumentation, deployment of sensors and cables, operation of seismic sources, field data quality control, troubleshooting, and equipment mobilization.
Supporting geodetic, geological, and geotechnical services including surveying, GIS mapping, geologic mapping, vibration and settlement monitoring, soil borings, and rock coring.
Operating specialized geophysical, survey, and data-acquisition equipment and progressively developing the skills necessary to independently perform increasingly complex field and office assignments.
Conducting specific phases of projects and assigned field activities under the general supervision of a Project Manager or senior technical team member.
Evaluating field data in real time, identifying potential problems or unexpected conditions, and working with senior staff to determine appropriate solutions.
Reviewing collected data for completeness and quality and identifying data that may require additional investigation or collection.
Maintaining organized field documentation and digital data and performing appropriate quality-control checks.
Preparing technical documentation, figures, maps, summaries, and portions of technical reports.
Working collaboratively as part of multidisciplinary project teams and small field crews.
Traveling up to approximately 50% as project needs require.
Taking ownership of assigned tasks and progressively assuming greater responsibility for field activities and technical assignments.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

About the Job.

JPI is seeking an Architectural Project Coordinator to support the design, production, and construction administration of multifamily projects. This position reports directly to the Director of Architectural Production and plays a key role within the Architectural Production Studio by helping coordinate design efforts across all project phases.

The ideal candidate will bring 3-7 years of multifamily experience and a strong ability to support architectural production in a fast-paced environment. This role offers hands-on exposure to schematic design, design development, construction documents, and construction administration, while working closely with Project Architects, Studio Directors, consultants, and internal JPI teams. The Architectural Project Coordinator helps transform design concepts into coordinated drawing sets, supports consultant integration, and assists with construction-phase documentation to ensure smooth project delivery.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

Project Coordination: Support the Architectural Project Manager in coordinating multiple projects through all phases from schematic design to construction administration. Assist with tracking project schedules, deliverables, and coordination items to ensure milestones are met. Help organize internal and external coordination meetings, page turns, and design reviews.
Design and Documentation: Assist in the production and coordination of schematic design (SD), design development (DD), and construction documents (CD).
Utilize a kit of parts approach to architectural design, leveraging pre-approved components to streamline the design process and maximize efficiency.

Construction Administration: Support the CA department with RFI inquiries.
Team Coordination: Coordinate with external consultants (Civil engineers, MEP engineers, interior designers, contractors, and other stakeholders) to support cohesive project delivery.
Assist senior staff in managing communication and follow-up items across disciplines.

Teamwork: Work closely with the Senior Project Manager, the Architectural Production Studio Director, and the Architectural CA Studio Director to support staffing, workflow, and phase transitions.
JPI Departments: Collaborate with internal design teams, development, investment management, preconstruction, and construction to integrate architectural design requirements into overall project planning.
Quality Control: Assist with internal quality reviews to ensure drawing sets align with building codes, JPI standards, and construction requirements. Help track and verify incorporation of value engineering items, accessibility comments, and waterproofing review comments.
Client and Stakeholder Management: Support project communication by helping prepare materials, tracking responses, and documenting decisions. Assist in maintaining clear communication between internal teams and external partners.
Resource Management: Help track project timelines, consultant deliverables, and internal deadlines. Assist with workload coordination and task prioritization as directed by the Director of Design.
Innovation and Problem-Solving: Contribute to architectural design with creative solutions and innovative approaches. Identify and address design challenges throughout the project lifecycle.
Industry Knowledge: Stay updated on the latest trends, technologies, and best practices in multifamily architecture and construction, integrating them into the design and documentation process.

Pre-Dev / Conceptual Design Phase
Conceptual Design Analysis: Assist with reviewing site plans and elevation studies for coordination, zoning compliance, and completeness.
Kit of Parts Evaluation: Assess the application of the “kit of parts” approach in the site plan, focusing on standardization to streamline future production efforts while maintaining design integrity.
Concept Set Review: Assist with the review of the concept set, ensuring it is complete and aligns with the overall project strategy. Provide feedback and markups to ensure readiness for the next design phase.
Visual Communication: Support elevation and graphic reviews for internal discussions and presentations.
Collaborative Leadership: Assist the Senior Project Manager with organizing consultant proposals and tracking scopes.

Schematic Design Phase – Arch Production Studio
Civil Coordination: Assist with tracking site constraints and civil coordination items.
Third-Party Consultant Integration: Facilitate coordination between in-house teams and external consultants, ensuring all stakeholders (structural, MEP, interior design, and landscape architecture) are aligned and progressing according to the project schedule.
Detailed Unit Approval: Assist with tracking unit layout approvals and internal sign-offs.
Schematic Design Set Delivery: Support the production of a fully coordinated Schematic Design (SD) set in Revit, managing both in-house and outsourced resources, and ensuring timely delivery to internal and external stakeholders.
Value Engineering (VE) Review: Track VE items and document decisions made during SD reviews.

Development Phase – Arch Production Studio
Drawing Quality Control: Assist with organizing DD reviews and incorporating markups. Ensure all drawings meet project specifications and JPI’s high-quality standards.
Integration of Value Engineering: Assist with organizing DD reviews and incorporating markups.
Design Coordination: Assist coordination efforts across all disciplines (architectural, structural, MEP) through the DD Pageturn meeting. Ensure full collaboration between internal and external teams, identifying and resolving any design conflicts early in the process.
Documentation & Feedback: Issue the DD set and the DD Revised set to all relevant parties and actively participate in design discussions to ensure feedback is incorporated promptly.

Construction Documents Phase – Arch Production Studio
CD Coordination: Assist with coordinating architectural, structural, and MEP inputs into the CD set.
Consultant Collaboration: Help organize CD pageturn meetings and track follow-up items.
Compliance Tracking: Assist with incorporating accessibility and waterproofing review comments.
Permit & GMP Set Support: Help prepare and organize CD sets for permit and GMP pricing issuance.

IFC Set & Preconstruction – Arch CA Studio
Assist with verifying that permit comments, accessibility comments, waterproofing comments, and coordination items are incorporated into the final IFC set.

Construction Administration – Arch CA Studio
RFI & Submittal Assistance: Assist the CA department in responding to RFIs and submittals by preparing background information, markups, and reference materials for review by the CA team. This role does not issue responses directly to contractors.
Design Intent Support: Help verify that RFI and submittal responses align with the approved design intent, construction documents, and JPI standards under the direction of the CA team.
Construction Issue Support: Provide design support to the CA team for field-related questions, helping research drawings, details, and prior decisions to facilitate timely responses.

Non-essential Duties And Responsibilities

Other duties as assigned.

Education, Work Experience, & Physical Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Architecture.
